_comment: Hand-authored rename supplement for cross-version block-schema diffing (architecture decision 12's hand-authored-supplement fallback). The pinned dumps (mojang-blocks.json) name every block that exists at a version, but never a mapping between versions -- a name that disappears in one adjacent-version diff and a different name that appears in the same diff is NOT provably the same block renamed; it is equally consistent with one block being removed and an unrelated block being added. The generator (xtask/src/codegen/palette/diff.rs) never infers a rename from that coincidence on its own. This file is the only place two differently-named blocks are asserted to be the same block across a version step, and only ever by a human attaching real evidence.
requirements: Every entry below MUST carry a non-empty `provenance` field naming a source outside this repo's own guesswork -- a changelog entry, release note, or commit that documents the rename, not a plausible-looking name pair. `from_version` and `to_version` must each be one of the manifest's pinned `game_version` triples, and must name an *adjacent* pair in the pinned ladder (the diff step the rename applies to), matching `manifest.json`'s `entries` list. The generator hard-fails a run whose rename entry does not resolve to an actual removed name (`from`) and added name (`to`) in that exact step's diff, so a stale or malformed entry cannot silently stop applying.
